title: M6 kernel fiber cardinality with full polynomial multiplicities
scope: Concrete multiplication annihilator cardinality, an original section2 ingredient.

spec.name: M6.KernelFibers.embed_mk
spec.statement: ∀ (F K : M6.KernelFibers.BP) (hF : F.Monic) (h : M6.KernelFibers.BP), M6.KernelFibers.embed F K hF (AdjoinRoot.mk F h) = AdjoinRoot.mk (F*K) (K*h)
spec.guidance: Use modByMonicHom_mk and AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_mk. F divides h-h%ₘF; F*K divides K times this difference. Explicit polynomial quotient/remainder identities. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.KernelFibers.embed_injective
spec.statement: ∀ (F K : M6.KernelFibers.BP) (hF : F.Monic), K ≠ 0 → Function.Injective (M6.KernelFibers.embed F K hF)
spec.guidance: Induct both inputs using AdjoinRoot.induction_on; use embed_mk and mk_eq_mk. Cancel nonzero K in divisibility to obtain F divides difference; mk_eq_mk again. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.KernelFibers.embed_annihilated
spec.statement: ∀ (F K : M6.KernelFibers.BP) (hF : F.Monic) (z : AdjoinRoot F), AdjoinRoot.mk (F*K) F * M6.KernelFibers.embed F K hF z = 0
spec.guidance: Represent z by a polynomial, rewrite embed_mk then ←map_mul; mk_eq_zero and witness h. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.KernelFibers.embed_surjective_kernel
spec.statement: ∀ (F K : M6.KernelFibers.BP) (hF : F.Monic) (z : AdjoinRoot (F*K)), AdjoinRoot.mk (F*K) F * z = 0 → ∃ t : AdjoinRoot F, M6.KernelFibers.embed F K hF t = z
spec.guidance: Represent z=mk h. mk_eq_zero gives F*K divides F*h. Cancel nonzero F using hF.ne_zero to get K divides h, write h=K*t, choose mk F t. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.KernelFibers.quotient_card
spec.guidance: Use AdjoinRoot.powerBasisAux' hF and its equivFun: quotient linearly equivalent to Fin degree→ZMod2. Nat.card_congr, Nat.card_fun and ZMod.card give result, including degree zero. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.KernelFibers.annihilator_card
spec.statement: ∀ (F K : M6.KernelFibers.BP), F.Monic → K ≠ 0 → Nat.card (M6.KernelFibers.annihilator F K) = 2^F.natDegree
spec.guidance: Build a bijection AdjoinRoot F to annihilator from embed and its three accepted lemmas, use Equiv.ofBijective and Nat.card_congr then quotient_card. Return tactic lines without leading by.
